text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickey! Lucky! Extra happy! ☆ It's
Copano Rickey
here to make your day
brighter!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm on a mission to prove the power of
feng shui through races, and inspire
people to adopt it into their lifestyles!
Then everyone'll be extra super 
fortunate!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For starters, let's brush up your office's
layout. This is gonna be our home base,
so we wanna get
the good energy
flowing! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
